source_span: we think the move is a bear-steepener: the front end is anchored by a Fed on hold, so the long end is doing the work as term premium rebuilds
source_chain: 10-year breaks 4.40% therefore JPM reads it as a bear-steepener because the front end is anchored by a Fed on hold while the long end rises on rebuilding term premium therefore JPM pays 5s30s at 62bp, stop 48bp; invalidation: a hot core PCE (0.3% m/m consensus) would validate the steepener, and a soft print would NOT by itself reverse it while the Fed stays on hold
pulse_chain: 10-year breaks 4.40% therefore markets are pricing the next hike with the front end leading and dragging the long end up, a bear-flattener therefore JPM pays 5s30s at 62bp, stop 48bp; invalidation: a soft core PCE print reverses the trade
why: The pulse inverts JPM's actual call (a bear-steepener driven by a long end rising while the front end sits anchored on hold) into an opposite bear-flattener led by the front end, and it reverses the note's invalidation condition, which explicitly says a soft PCE print would NOT by itself reverse the trade while the Fed stays on hold.
